summary: Iteration 8 — Tested new GET /api/books/{id}/related endpoint and BookDetail related-section UI. Added 5 new pytest tests to test_digilib_api.py; all 33 tests pass (28 regression + 5 new = 100%). Frontend flow verified end-to-end: related-section renders on modal open, source book is never in its own recs, clicking a related card swaps the modal and re-fetches recommendations, reasons match spec patterns (Sering dipinjam bersama / {Category} · {Type} / Kategori {Category} / Sesuai riwayat bacaan Anda / Pilihan pustakawan). Anonymous and authenticated (andi) both work; andi with prior loan history correctly surfaces 'Sesuai riwayat bacaan Anda' on multiple cards. No bugs found in this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py related_books auth section (L432-450): manual JWT decoding is duplicated from the auth dependency. Consider extracting `optional_current_user(request)` helper to avoid drift with the primary auth middleware (e.g., cookie name, algorithm changes).

related_books excludes ALL of the caller's historical loans from exclude_ids (line 449-450 iterates every loan doc regardless of status/returned_at). Per spec only ACTIVELY loaned books should be excluded; currently a returned loan also excludes that book from future recommendations. Consider filtering `{'user_id': caller['_id'], 'returned_at': None}` (or by status).
server.py now ~991 lines — still monolithic. Consider splitting into routers/books.py, routers/loans.py, routers/related.py.
Featured-fallback branch (L507) only fires when scored < limit — good — but the returned list is not re-truncated after adding fallbacks; the final sort+slice at L519 handles it. Confirmed OK.
Related endpoint has no rate limiting / caching — every modal open triggers ~4 mongo queries + 1 aggregate. Acceptable for MVP; consider Redis or in-memory LRU for prod.
